text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Most of the meetings between senior members of the ruling ZANU-PF party, ministers and war veterans held around the country over the weekend turned nasty with the riot squad having to intervene in Harare to rescue three ministers from a situation that was deteriorating into violence.

- The Zimbabwe Electricity Supply Authority has received a consignment of power cables, transformers and electrical conductors worth Z$33 million to help reduce the backlog in its housing electrification programme.
